# Mimir Collective

> Privacy infrastructure for Web3 finance, tokenized assets and onchain markets, addressing emerging opportunities on Robinhood Chain today and preparing for tomorrow's quantum threat.

Mimir Collective researches and builds privacy infrastructure for Web3 finance, tokenized assets and onchain markets. We build private payments infrastructure for onchain finance, built on zero-knowledge circuits. Live selling is the first deployment.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.mimircollective.io/): Privacy for on-chain finance.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.mimircollective.io/privacy.html): What Mimir Collective collects, and what it does not.
- [FAQ](https://www.mimircollective.io/faq.html): Questions about Mimir Collective, answered.

## Libraries

- [noir-sparse-merkle](https://github.com/mimir-collective/noir-sparse-merkle): A Sparse Merkle Tree circuit for Noir that proves a key either belongs to, or is absent from, a committed tree root.
- [poseidon2-interop-kit](https://github.com/mimir-collective/poseidon2-interop-kit): An open-source Poseidon2 kit that standardizes hashing across Noir, Rust, and Solidity for privacy systems using sparse Merkle trees and note/nullifier flows.
- [noir-nullifier](https://github.com/mimir-collective/noir-nullifier): A ZK spend circuit for Noir that proves note ownership and prevents double-spends without revealing which note is being spent.
